        "contents": "class AiSearchService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取配置的工作流\n   */\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;WorkflowConfig | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流，传递pageType参数\n      const params = pageType ? &#96;?pageType=${pageType}&#96; : '';\n      const response = await api.get(&#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        // 如果API返回了完整的配置，直接使用\n        if (response.data.data.config) {\n          return response.data.data.config;\n        }\n        // 如果只返回了workflowId，需要从API获取工作流详情\n        if (response.data.data.workflowId) {\n          const workflowResponse = await api.get(&#96;/workflow/${response.data.data.workflowId}&#96;);\n          if (workflowResponse.data.success &amp;&amp; workflowResponse.data.data) {\n            return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflowResponse.data.data);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果没有配置，返回null，让调用方处理\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\n   */\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'input');\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\n\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\n\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\n\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&#96;\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\n- **调用方法**: &#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&#96;\n- **特点**: \n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\n  - 支持多轮对话\n  - 支持上下文管理\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\n\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&#96;\n- **调用节点1**: &#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&#96; - 直接执行AI角色\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\n  \n- **调用节点2**: &#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&#96; - 执行工作流\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\n  \n- **调用节点3**: &#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\n\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&#96;\n- **调用节点1**: &#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&#96; - AI搜索\n- **调用节点2**: &#96;techPackage(inputs)&#96; - 技术包装\n- **调用节点3**: &#96;techStrategy(inputs)&#96; - 技术策略\n- **调用节点4**: &#96;techArticle(inputs)&#96; - 技术通稿\n- **调用节点5**: &#96;coreDraft(inputs)&#96; - 核心稿件\n- **调用节点6**: &#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&#96; - 技术发布\n- **调用节点7**: &#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&#96; - 通用应用调用\n- **调用节点8**: &#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&#96; - 工作流调用\n\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&#96;\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| &#96;/tech-package&#96; | TechPackagePage | BaseAISearchPage | techPackageConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | TechStrategyPage | BaseAISearchPage | techStrategyConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-article&#96; | TechArticlePage | BaseAISearchPage | techArticleConfig |\n| &#96;/press-release&#96; | PressReleasePage | BaseAISearchPage | pressReleaseConfig |\n| &#96;/ai-qa&#96; | AIQAPage | BaseAISearchPage | aiQaConfig |\n| &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/ai-qa&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | NodePage | TechPackageNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | NodePage | PromotionStrategyNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | NodePage | CoreDraftNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/speech&#96; | NodePage | PressReleasePage | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点\n\n工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）中可用的节点类型：\n\n| 节点类型 | 是否有效 | 使用场景 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;agent&#96; | ✅ 是 | 调用AI角色执行任务 |\n| &#96;input&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输入 |\n| &#96;output&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输出 |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | ✅ 是 | 条件分支判断 |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | ✅ 是 | 变量赋值 |\n| &#96;merge&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据合并 |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据转换 |\n| &#96;memory&#96; | ✅ 是 | 文本存储 |\n\n## 三、节点配置依赖关系\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 创建AI角色\n   ├─ source: 'independent-page'\n   ├─ provider: 'dify' 或 'direct-agent'\n   └─ 名称/ID匹配节点类型\n\n2. 配置Dify连接（如果provider为dify）\n   ├─ connectionType: 'chatflow' 或 'workflow'\n   ├─ apiKey: Dify API密钥\n   └─ apiUrl: Dify服务器地址\n\n3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）",

        "contents": "| &#96;workflow&#96; | 工作流调用 | ✅ 已实现 | 使用LangGraphEngine执行工作流 |\n| &#96;agent&#96; | Agent嵌套调用 | ✅ 已实现 | 支持最多3层嵌套，防止无限递归 |\n\n**工具调用流程**:\n1. 解析工具调用参数（JSON格式）\n2. 验证参数（类型、必需性、枚举值）\n3. 根据工具类型执行相应逻辑\n4. 返回JSON格式的执行结果\n\n### 2.5 DifyClient（Dify客户端）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&#96;\n\n**职责**:\n- 封装Dify平台API调用\n- 管理不同应用的Gateway实例\n- 统一响应格式转换\n\n**支持的应用类型**:\n- &#96;ai-search&#96;: AI搜索\n- &#96;tech-package&#96;: 技术包装\n- &#96;tech-strategy&#96;: 技术策略\n- &#96;tech-article&#96;: 技术通稿\n- &#96;core-draft&#96;: 核心稿件\n- &#96;tech-publish&#96;: 技术发布\n\n**调用模式**:\n- **Chatflow模式**: 对话式应用，支持多轮对话\n- **Workflow模式**: 工作流应用，结构化输出\n\n### 2.6 LangGraphEngine（工作流引擎）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/workflow/langgraph/LangGraphEngine.ts&#96;\n\n**职责**:\n- 执行基于DAG的工作流\n- 拓扑排序节点执行顺序\n- 管理共享上下文（sharedContext）\n\n**支持的节点类型**:\n- &#96;input&#96;: 输入节点\n- &#96;agent&#96;: Agent节点（调用AI角色）\n- &#96;output&#96;: 输出节点\n- &#96;condition&#96;: 条件判断节点\n- &#96;assign&#96;: 变量赋值节点\n- &#96;transform&#96;: 数据转换节点\n- &#96;merge&#96;: 数据合并节点\n- &#96;memory&#96;: 文本记忆节点\n\n**执行特点**:\n- 按层级并行执行（同一层节点可并行）\n- 支持条件边（gating）：根据条件决定是否执行节点\n- 共享上下文传递：节点间通过&#96;sharedContext&#96;共享数据\n- **支持Direct Agent**: Agent节点可以调用Direct Agent类型的AI角色\n\n**局限性**:\n- 不支持循环（Cycles）\n- 节点扩展性差（硬编码switch-case）\n- 状态管理简单（仅依靠sharedContext）\n\n---\n\n## 三、信息处理链路\n\n### 3.1 Direct Agent执行链路\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户输入\n  ↓\n前端页面组件 (AIChatPage/AIRoleChatPage)\n  ↓",

        "contents": "import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\nimport ProjectPageLayout from '../components/project/ProjectPageLayout';\nimport EmbeddedTechPackagePage from '../components/embedded-pages/EmbeddedTechPackagePage';\n\nconst ProjectTechPackagePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { projectId } = useParams&lt;{ projectId: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&lt;Project | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      loadProject();\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!project || !projectId) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center\"&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-gray-500 mb-4\"&gt;项目不存在&lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={() =&gt; navigate('/')}\n            className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700\"\n          &gt;\n            返回首页\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ProjectPageLayout\n      project={project}\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取工作流配置\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/workflow?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/workflow', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows() as any[];\n    \n    // 根据页面类型选择不同的环境变量或默认工作流\n    let workflowIdFromEnv: string | null = null;\n    if (pageType === 'press-release') {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.PRESS_RELEASE_WORKFLOW_ID || process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    } else {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    }\n\n    let resolvedWorkflowId: string | null = null;\n    const workflowsArray = workflows as any[];\n\n    if (workflowIdFromEnv) {\n      const matched = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.id === workflowIdFromEnv);\n      if (matched) {\n        resolvedWorkflowId = matched.id;\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('工作流ID指定的工作流不存在，已自动回退', {\n          workflowId: workflowIdFromEnv,\n          pageType,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!resolvedWorkflowId) {\n      // 根据页面类型选择默认工作流名称\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      resolvedWorkflowId = defaultWorkflow?.id || workflowsArray[0]?.id || null;\n    }\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        true,\n        { workflowId: resolvedWorkflowId },\n        '获取工作流配置成功'\n      )\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取工作流配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "const ProjectManagementPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { projectId } = useParams&lt;{ projectId: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&lt;Project | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [selectedTechPoint, setSelectedTechPoint] = useState&lt;TechPoint | null&gt;(null);\n  const [rightPanelContent, setRightPanelContent] = useState&lt;RightPanelContent&gt;(null);\n  const [techPointListRefreshTrigger, setTechPointListRefreshTrigger] = useState(0);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      loadProject();\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 处理从技术点库返回的选中技术点\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const selectedTechPointIds = searchParams.get('selectedTechPointIds');\n    if (selectedTechPointIds &amp;&amp; projectId) {\n      handleAddTechPointsFromLibrary(selectedTechPointIds);\n    }\n  }, [searchParams, projectId]);\n\n  const handleAddTechPointsFromLibrary = async (selectedTechPointIdsStr: string)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "- Workflow模式：&#96;DifyClient.runWorkflow()&#96; → &#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&#96;\n\n### 1.3 业务页面对应的AI功能\n\n| 页面类型 | 页面标题 | 启用工具数 | 主要AI功能 | 配置位置 |\n|---------|---------|-----------|-----------|---------|\n| **tech-package** | 技术包装 | 8个 | 五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具视频、翻译、讲稿、脚本 | &#96;pageConfigs.ts&#96; |\n| **press-release** | 发布会稿 | 6个 | 技术转译、场景挖掘、场景化、口语化、翻译、讲稿 | &#96;pageConfigs.ts&#96; |\n| **tech-strategy** | 技术策略 | 4个 | 传播策略、技术转译、场景挖掘、翻译 | &#96;pageConfigs.ts&#96; |\n| **tech-article** | 技术通稿 | 2个 | 技术讲稿、翻译 | &#96;pageConfigs.ts&#96; |\n| **ai-qa** | AI问答 | 0个 | 纯对话模式（无工具箱） | &#96;pageConfigs.ts&#96; |\n\n### 1.4 功能工具映射表\n\n| 工具ID | 工具名称 | 页面映射 | 说明 |\n|-------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;five-view-analysis&#96; | 五看/技术转译 | tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article | 技术转译分析 |\n| &#96;three-fix-analysis&#96; | 三定/用户场景挖掘 | tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy | 用户场景分析 |\n| &#96;tech-matrix&#96; | 技术矩阵 | tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy | 技术矩阵生成 |\n| &#96;propagation-strategy&#96; | 传播策略/领导人口语化 | tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy | 传播策略生成 |\n| &#96;exhibition-video&#96; | 展具与视频 | tech-package, tech-strategy | 展具视频方案 |\n| &#96;translation&#96; | 翻译 | 所有页面 | 多语言翻译 |\n| &#96;ppt-outline&#96; | 技术讲稿 | tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article | PPT大纲生成 |\n| &#96;script&#96; | 脚本 | tech-package, tech-strategy | 脚本生成 |\n\n### 1.5 工具类型完整清单\n\n| 工具类型 | 功能描述 | 实现状态 | 实现方式 | 安全特性 |\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;search&#96; | AI搜索 | ✅ 已实现 | 调用 &#96;DifyClient.aiSearch()&#96; | ✅ 安全 |\n| &#96;calculation&#96; | 数学计算 | ✅ 已实现 | 使用 &#96;mathjs&#96; 库 | ✅ 防代码注入 |",

        },
        "contents": "export class TechArticleAggregationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 聚合多个数据源并生成多版本通稿\n   */\n  async aggregateAndGenerate(options: AggregateOptions): Promise&lt;MultiVersionArticle&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 1. 收集所有来源数据\n      const sourceData = await this.collectSourceData(\n        options.conversationIds,\n        options.outputIds\n      );\n\n      // 2. 构建工作流输入\n      const workflowInput = this.buildWorkflowInput(sourceData, options);\n\n      // 3. 解析工作流ID（从环境变量或配置）\n      const workflowId = options.workflowId || process.env.TECH_ARTICLE_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        throw new Error('未配置技术通稿工作流ID，请设置 TECH_ARTICLE_WORKFLOW_ID 环境变量');\n      }\n\n      // 4. 调用Dify工作流\n      logger.info('调用技术通稿生成工作流', {\n        workflowId,\n        conversationCount: options.conversationIds.length,\n        outputCount: options.outputIds.length,\n        articleTypes: options.articleTypes,\n      });\n\n      const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, {\n        input: workflowInput,\n      });\n\n      if (!workflowResult.success || !workflowResult.data) {\n        throw new Error(\n          workflowResult.message || '工作流执行失败，未返回有效数据'\n        );\n      }\n\n      // 5. 解析工作流输出\n      const outputs = this.parseWorkflowOutput(workflowResult.data);\n\n      // 6. 构建返回结果\n      const result: MultiVersionArticle = {\n        sourceReferences: sourceData.references,\n        metadata: {\n          generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          workflowId,\n          tokenUsage: this.extractTokenUsage(workflowResult.data),\n        },\n      };\n\n      // 根据请求的文章类型填充结果\n      if (options.articleTypes.includes('media_release') &amp;&amp; outputs.mediaRelease) {\n        result.mediaRelease = outputs.mediaRelease;\n      }\n      if (options.articleTypes.includes('internal_memo') &amp;&amp; outputs.internalMemo) {\n        result.internalMemo = outputs.internalMemo;\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [

mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType === targetPageType\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 找到匹配的配置:', mapping.workflowId);\n            setSelectedWorkflowId(mapping.workflowId);\n            // 尝试将workflowId匹配到AI角色\n            const matchingRole = roles.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === mapping.workflowId);\n            if (matchingRole &amp;&amp; matchingRole.enabled) {\n              setSelectedRoleIdForMapping(mapping.workflowId);\n            }\n            // 如果找不到匹配的角色，保持workflowId不变，但selectedRoleIdForMapping为空，用户需要手动选择\n            \n            // 加载技术包装页面已配置的 AI 模块\n            const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n              .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === targetPageType)\n              .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n            \n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 已配置的 AI 模块:', configuredFeatures);\n            \n            if (configuredFeatures.length &gt; 0) {\n              setSelectedFeatureTypes(configuredFeatures);\n            }\n            return; // 找到配置后直接返回\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "| &#96;three-fix-analysis&#96; | 三定/用户场景挖掘 | tech-package, tech-strategy, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-matrix&#96; | 技术矩阵 | tech-package, tech-strategy, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;propagation-strategy&#96; | 传播策略 | tech-package, tech-strategy | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;exhibition-video&#96; | 展具与视频 | tech-package, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;translation&#96; | 翻译 | 所有页面 | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;ppt-outline&#96; | 技术讲稿 | tech-package, tech-strategy, tech-article | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;script&#96; | 脚本 | tech-package, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\n\n**配置要求：**\n- 在字段映射管理页面配置\n- 每个功能可以关联工作流ID或AI角色ID\n- 支持按pageType区分配置（tech-package, tech-strategy, tech-article, press-release）\n- 需要配置输入输出字段映射\n\n**配置位置：** 字段映射管理页面 (&#96;/field-mapping-management&#96;)\n\n## 二、前端页面中实际使用的有效节点\n\n### 1. 路由配置分析\n\n根据 &#96;App.tsx&#96; 的路由配置，以下页面是有效的：\n\n#### 标准独立页面路由（5个）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n/tech-package      → TechPackagePage\n/tech-strategy     → TechStrategyPage\n/tech-article      → TechArticlePage\n/press-release     → PressReleasePage\n/ai-qa             → AIQAPage\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 节点页面路由（动态）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n/node/:nodeType     → NodePage\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n支持的nodeType：\n- &#96;ai-search&#96; → AiSearchNode\n- &#96;ai-qa&#96; → AiSearchNode（复用）\n- &#96;tech-package&#96; → TechPackageNode\n- &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; → PromotionStrategyNode\n- &#96;core-draft&#96; → CoreDraftNode\n- &#96;speech&#96; → PressReleasePage（映射）\n\n#### 向后兼容路由\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n/ai-search          → 重定向到 /tech-package\n/tech-publish       → 重定向到 /press-release\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "**配置位置：** 字段映射管理页面 (&#96;/field-mapping-management&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "## 二、前端页面中实际使用的有效节点",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 路由配置分析",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "根据 &#96;App.tsx&#96; 的路由配置，以下页面是有效的：",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 标准独立页面路由（5个）",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "/tech-package      → TechPackagePage",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "/tech-strategy     → TechStrategyPage",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "/tech-article      → TechArticlePage",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "/press-release     → PressReleasePage",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "/ai-qa             → AIQAPage",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 节点页面路由（动态）",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "/node/:nodeType     → NodePage",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "支持的nodeType：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ai-search&#96; → AiSearchNode",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ai-qa&#96; → AiSearchNode（复用）",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;tech-package&#96; → TechPackageNode",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; → PromotionStrategyNode",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;core-draft&#96; → CoreDraftNode",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;speech&#96; → PressReleasePage（映射）",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 向后兼容路由",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "/ai-search          → 重定向到 /tech-package",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "/tech-publish       → 重定向到 /press-release",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 页面组件映射",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|---------|--------------|---------|",

          }
        ]

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析\n\n本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。\n\n## 一、需要配置的节点类型\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n这些节点对应独立的页面路由，需要配置AI角色（source: 'independent-page'）：\n\n| 节点ID | 节点名称 | 路由路径 | 页面组件 | 状态 |\n|--------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | AiSearchNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | TechPackageNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | PromotionStrategyNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 核心稿件 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | CoreDraftNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | PressReleasePage | ✅ 有效（映射到press-release） |\n\n**配置要求：**\n- 需要在AI角色管理系统中创建对应的AI角色\n- source必须设置为 &#96;'independent-page'&#96;\n- 角色ID或名称需要匹配节点类型（通过正则表达式匹配）\n- 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\n\n**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ai-search 匹配模式\n/ai-search/i, /ai问答/i, /智能搜索/i, /smart-search/i\n\n// tech-package 匹配模式\n/tech-package/i, /技术包装/i\n\n// promotion-strategy 匹配模式\n/promotion-strategy/i, /tech-strategy/i, /技术策略/i, /推广策略/i\n\n// core-draft 匹配模式\n/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i\n\n// speech 匹配模式\n/speech/i, /发布会/i, /演讲稿/i, /tech-publish/i\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 标准页面节点（5个）\n\n这些是标准化的独立页面，使用BaseAISearchPage组件：\n\n| 页面类型 | 页面名称 | 路由路径 | 配置文件 | 状态 |\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/tech-package&#96; | techPackageConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-article&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/tech-article&#96; | techArticleConfig | ✅ 有效 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析",

            "text": "本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。",

            "lineNumber": 4

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**",

            "lineNumber": 34

          {

          {
            "text": "// core-draft 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i",
            "lineNumber": 37

          {

          {

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\n\n    try {\n      let inputs: any;\n\n      if (searchResults &amp;&amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;&amp; searchResults.query) {\n        inputs = {\n          query: searchResults.query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\n        };\n      } else {\n        inputs = {\n          searchResults: searchResults,\n          template: template,\n        };\n      }\n\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-package\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech package API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术策略\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techPackage },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| &#96;/tech-package&#96; | TechPackagePage | BaseAISearchPage | techPackageConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | TechStrategyPage | BaseAISearchPage | techStrategyConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-article&#96; | TechArticlePage | BaseAISearchPage | techArticleConfig |\n| &#96;/press-release&#96; | PressReleasePage | BaseAISearchPage | pressReleaseConfig |\n| &#96;/ai-qa&#96; | AIQAPage | BaseAISearchPage | aiQaConfig |\n| &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/ai-qa&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | NodePage | TechPackageNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | NodePage | PromotionStrategyNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | NodePage | CoreDraftNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/speech&#96; | NodePage | PressReleasePage | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点\n\n工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）中可用的节点类型：\n\n| 节点类型 | 是否有效 | 使用场景 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;agent&#96; | ✅ 是 | 调用AI角色执行任务 |\n| &#96;input&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输入 |\n| &#96;output&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输出 |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | ✅ 是 | 条件分支判断 |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | ✅ 是 | 变量赋值 |\n| &#96;merge&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据合并 |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据转换 |\n| &#96;memory&#96; | ✅ 是 | 文本存储 |\n\n## 三、节点配置依赖关系\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 创建AI角色\n   ├─ source: 'independent-page'\n   ├─ provider: 'dify' 或 'direct-agent'\n   └─ 名称/ID匹配节点类型\n\n2. 配置Dify连接（如果provider为dify）\n   ├─ connectionType: 'chatflow' 或 'workflow'\n   ├─ apiKey: Dify API密钥\n   └─ apiUrl: Dify服务器地址\n\n3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）",
        "signatures": {},

item.contentType === \"knowledge_point\",\n          ),\n        }, undefined, undefined, conversationId);\n      }\n\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\n        if (response.data?.conversationId) {\n          setConversationId(response.data.conversationId);\n        }\n        \n        // 处理Dify工作流的响应格式\n        const responseData = response.data;\n        let content = \"\";\n\n        // 尝试从不同的字段获取内容\n        if (responseData.data &amp;&amp; responseData.data.outputs) {\n          // Dify工作流响应格式\n          const outputs = responseData.data.outputs;\n          content =\n            outputs.answer || outputs.text || outputs.reasoning_content || \"\";\n        } else if (responseData.answer) {\n          // 直接的answer字段\n          content = responseData.answer;\n        } else if (responseData.content) {\n          // 传统的content字段\n          content = responseData.content;\n        } else {\n          // 默认内容\n          content = \"技术包装方案已生成，请查看右侧编辑区域进行进一步完善。\";\n        }\n\n        setAiResponse(content);\n\n        // 设置已生成状态为true\n        setHasGenerated(true);\n\n        // 添加AI响应到历史记录\n        const aiMessage: ChatMessage = {\n          id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\n          type: \"ai\",\n          content: content,\n          timestamp: Date.now() + 1,\n        };\n        setChatHistory((prev) =&gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\n\n        // 执行工作流\n        if (onExecute) {\n          onExecute({\n            query,\n            response: content,\n            selectedKnowledgePoints: selectedItems,\n            rawResponse: responseData,\n            userContent: userContent, // 添加编辑区内容\n          });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const errorContent = \"生成失败，请重试。\";\n;\n;",

Response: ${JSON.stringify(chatResponse, null, 2)}&#96;);\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      workflow_run_id: &#96;chat-${chatResponse.id}&#96;,\n      task_id: chatResponse.task_id,\n      conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id, // 传递 conversation_id 用于多轮对话\n      data: {\n        id: chatResponse.id,\n        workflow_id: 'tech-package-chat',\n        status: 'succeeded',\n        outputs: {\n          text: chatResponse.answer || '',\n          answer: chatResponse.answer || ''\n        },\n        error: null,\n        elapsed_time: chatResponse.metadata?.usage?.latency || 0,\n        total_tokens: chatResponse.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens || 0,\n        total_steps: 1,\n        created_at: chatResponse.created_at || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),\n        finished_at: chatResponse.created_at || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  async techPackage(inputs: any): Promise&lt;DifyWorkflowResponse&gt; {\n    try\n  }",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: &#96;未找到功能对象映射配置: ${dto.featureType}&#96;,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 优先使用 agentId（AI角色ID），如果没有再使用 workflowId\n      // agentId 用于直接调用 AI 角色，workflowId 用于通过工作流调用\n      const configuredAgentId = (featureConfig as any).agentId;\n      const configuredWorkflowId = featureConfig.workflowId;\n      \n      // 如果配置了 agentId，使用它；否则使用 workflowId\n      // 注意：只有当 agentId 是不同的角色时才使用它，避免使用当前工作流\n      let targetWorkflowId: string;\n      if (configuredAgentId &amp;&amp; configuredAgentId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredAgentId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的 AI 角色', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          agentId: configuredAgentId,\n        });\n      } else if (configuredWorkflowId &amp;&amp; configuredWorkflowId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredWorkflowId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      } else {\n        targetWorkflowId = workflowId;\n        logger.warn('功能对象未配置专属 agentId 或 workflowId，将使用当前工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          fallbackWorkflowId: workflowId,\n          configuredAgentId,\n          configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      }\n      const targetMappingConfig = targetWorkflowId === workflowId\n        ? baseMappingConfig\n        : await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, targetWorkflowId);\n\n      const effectiveInputMappings = featureConfig.inputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.inputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.inputMappings || [];\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n;\n  }\n}",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  private async resolveBaseContent(conversation: any, dto: TriggerAgentDTO) {\n    let baseContent = dto.content;\n\n    if (!baseContent &amp;&amp; dto.messageId) {\n      const messageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getMessageById(dto.messageId);\n      baseContent = messageRecord?.content;\n    }\n\n    const sortedMessages = [...(conversation.messages || [])];\n    const lastUserMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n    // 过滤掉无效的助手消息内容（如\"工作流执行完成\"）\n    const invalidContents = ['工作流执行完成', '子Agent已执行', '触发子Agent'];\n    const lastValidAssistantMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find(\n      (m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant' &amp;&amp; \n             m.content &amp;&amp; \n             !invalidContents.some(invalid =&gt; m.content.startsWith(invalid))\n    );\n\n    // 优先使用用户消息作为输入（避免使用之前失败的助手回复）\n    if (!baseContent &amp;&amp; lastUserMessage) {\n      baseContent = lastUserMessage.content;\n    }\n\n    // 如果没有用户消息，使用有效的助手消息\n    if (!baseContent &amp;&amp; lastValidAssistantMessage) {\n      baseContent = lastValidAssistantMessage.content;\n    }\n\n    return baseContent;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 构建对话数据，包含根据contextWindowSize截取的上下文历史\n   * 此方法适用于所有工具（五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译等）\n   * @param conversation 对话对象\n   * @param conversationQuery 对话查询内容\n   * @param targetSources 目标来源\n   * @param dto 触发Agent的DTO，包含contextWindowSize参数\n   * @returns 包含历史上下文的对话数据\n   */\n}",

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 758
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 手动触发子Agent\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\n */\nrouter.post('/conversations/:id/agents', ensureTablesInitialized, async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const rawBody = req.body;\n    const dto = validateDTO(TriggerAgentSchema, rawBody);\n    // 确保 contextWindowSize 是 number 类型\n    const processedDto = {\n      ...dto,\n      contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n    };\n    const result = await triggerAgentUseCase.execute(id, processedDto);\n\n    if (!result.success) {\n      if (result.error.code === 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '对话不存在', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '未找到可用的工作流配置', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, result.error.message));\n      }\n\n      return res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '子Agent执行失败', result.error.message));\n    }\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result.value, '子Agent执行完成'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n      const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n      return res.status(400).json(failure);\n    }\n\n    logger.error('子Agent执行失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '子Agent执行失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除对话\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id\n */\nrouter.delete",

        "contents": "import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ConversationSummaryView } from '../dto/GetConversations.dto';\n\nexport class GetConversationsUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly aiSearchService: AiSearchService) {}\n\n  async execute(pageType?: string): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ConversationSummaryView[]&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversations = await this.aiSearchService.getConversations(pageType);\n\n      // 为每个对话获取第一条用户消息（用于显示标题）\n      const formatted = await Promise.all(\n        conversations.map(async (conv) =&gt; {\n          // 获取第一条用户消息\n          const firstUserMessage = await this.aiSearchService.getFirstUserMessage(conv.id);\n          \n          return {\n            id: conv.id,\n            title: conv.title,\n            sources: JSON.parse(conv.sources || '[]'),\n            messages: firstUserMessage ? [firstUserMessage] : [],\n            createdAt: new Date(conv.created_at),\n            updatedAt: new Date(conv.updated_at),\n          };\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success(formatted);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取对话列表失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'GET_CONVERSATIONS_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取对话列表失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        // 判断 finalWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n        // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头\n        const isRoleId = finalWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || finalWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n        \n        let workflowResult;\n        if (isRoleId) {\n          // 直接调用 AI 角色\n          logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        } else {\n          // 通过工作流调用\n          logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        }\n\n        // 检查执行结果\n        if\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp; context.history &amp;&amp; context.history.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 找到最后一条助手消息\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...context.history]\n        .reverse()\n        .find((msg: any) =&gt; msg.role === 'assistant');\n      \n      // 检查最后一条助手消息是否是子Agent的输出（hasOutputs 为 true 表示是工具生成的）\n      if (lastAssistantMessage &amp;&amp; lastAssistantMessage.hasOutputs) {\n        // 获取工具类型标签\n        const featureType = (params.conversation?.messages || [])\n          .find((m: any) =&gt; m.id === lastAssistantMessage.id)?.outputs?.metadata?.featureType;\n        const toolLabel = featureType ? this.getFeatureLabel(featureType) : '子Agent分析';\n        \n        // 将子Agent的输出作为上下文\n        const contentPreview = lastAssistantMessage.content.length &gt; 2000\n          ? lastAssistantMessage.content.substring(0, 2000) + '\\n...(内容已截断)'\n          : lastAssistantMessage.content;\n        \n        toolOutputContext = &#96;\\n\\n=== ${toolLabel}结果（请参考以下内容继续对话）===\\n${contentPreview}&#96;;\n        \n        logger.info('检测到上一条消息是子Agent输出，将其作为上下文', {\n          messageId: lastAssistantMessage.id,\n          featureType: featureType || 'unknown',\n          toolLabel,\n          contentLength: lastAssistantMessage.content.length,\n          truncated: lastAssistantMessage.content.length &gt; 2000,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 将子Agent输出上下文合并到 query 中\n    if (toolOutputContext) {\n      finalQuery = finalQuery + toolOutputContext;\n      logger.info('合并子Agent输出到查询内容', {\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        contextLength: toolOutputContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { AiSearchService } from '@/services/AiSearchService';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\nimport { AggregateTechArticleDTO } from '../dto/AggregateTechArticle.dto';\n\nexport class AggregateTechArticleUseCase {\n  private aggregationService: TechArticleAggregationService;\n\n  constructor(private readonly aiSearchService: AiSearchService) {\n    this.aggregationService = new TechArticleAggregationService(aiSearchService);\n  }\n\n  async execute(dto: AggregateTechArticleDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始聚合生成技术通稿', {\n        conversationCount: dto.conversationIds.length,\n        outputCount: dto.outputIds?.length || 0,\n        articleTypes: dto.articleTypes,\n      });\n\n      const result = await this.aggregationService.aggregateAndGenerate({\n        conversationIds: dto.conversationIds,\n        outputIds: dto.outputIds || [],\n        articleTypes: dto.articleTypes,\n        tone: dto.tone,\n        targetAudience: dto.targetAudience,\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n      });\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('聚合生成技术通稿失败', { error, dto });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'AGGREGATE_TECH_ARTICLE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '聚合生成技术通稿失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nexport class GetOutputsUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly aiSearchService: AiSearchService) {}\n\n  async execute(conversationId?: string, pageType?: string): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any[]&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const outputs = await this.aiSearchService.getOutputs(conversationId, pageType);\n\n      const formatted = outputs.map((output) =&gt; ({\n        id: output.id,\n        type: output.type,\n        title: output.title,\n        content: JSON.parse(output.content || '{}'),\n        messageId: output.message_id,\n        conversationId: output.conversation_id,\n        createdAt: new Date(output.created_at),\n      }));\n\n      return success(formatted);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取输出内容列表失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'GET_OUTPUTS_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取输出内容列表失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取工作流配置\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/workflow?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/workflow', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows() as any[];\n    \n    // 根据页面类型选择不同的环境变量或默认工作流\n    let workflowIdFromEnv: string | null = null;\n    if (pageType === 'press-release') {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.PRESS_RELEASE_WORKFLOW_ID || process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    } else {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    }\n\n    let resolvedWorkflowId: string | null = null;\n    const workflowsArray = workflows as any[];\n\n    if (workflowIdFromEnv) {\n      const matched = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.id === workflowIdFromEnv);\n      if (matched) {\n        resolvedWorkflowId = matched.id;\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('工作流ID指定的工作流不存在，已自动回退', {\n          workflowId: workflowIdFromEnv,\n          pageType,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!resolvedWorkflowId) {\n      // 根据页面类型选择默认工作流名称\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      resolvedWorkflowId = defaultWorkflow?.id || workflowsArray[0]?.id || null;\n    }\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        true,\n        { workflowId: resolvedWorkflowId },\n        '获取工作流配置成功'\n      )\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取工作流配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 23,
                "column": 1

## 问题分析与修复

### 问题1："未找到可用的工作流配置"错误

**原因**：
- `resolveWorkflowId()` 只查找工作流，未考虑 AI 角色 ID
- 技术包装页面应使用 `independent-page-tech-package` 作为主控 Agent，但系统未识别

**修复**：
1. 修改 `resolveWorkflowId()` 支持 AI 角色 ID：
   - 支持 `independent-page-*` 格式的 AI 角色 ID
   - 找不到工作流时，回退到技术包装页面的默认 AI 角色
   - 支持从环境变量读取 AI 角色 ID

2. 改进 `TriggerAgentUseCase`：
   - 从字段映射配置推断 `pageType`
   - 更准确地解析工作流 ID

### 问题2："五看"选项没有显示

**原因**：
- 工具显示逻辑仅依赖字段映射配置
- 如果字段映射配置中没有配置工具，即使默认配置中有也不会显示

**修复**：
1. 修改工具加载逻辑：
   - 合并字段映射配置和默认配置
   - 确保所有默认工具都能显示
   - 字段映射配置中的工具优先级更高

2. 改进工具显示过滤：
   - 如果没有 `pageType` 的配置，也显示（向后兼容）
   - 有 `pageType` 的配置优先级更高

## 修改的文件

1. `backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/utils/workflow.ts` - 支持 AI 角色 ID 解析
2. `backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts` - 改进功能对象配置查找
